authority: DEC-0012 correctness hotfix on the frozen v1 product; operator-authorized follow-up to the 2026-10-22 repository audit. The nulling is a machine second-desk ruling on obvious wrong subjects and awaits operator ratification at pull-request review before publication.
method: Every facet named wrong by either of two independent prior viewers, plus every facet the second viewer marked probable, was rendered on labelled contact sheets from the exact bytes bound in data/specimens.json (sha256 recorded per facet and equal to the data/MEDIA-AUDIT.json asset receipt) and inspected. A facet was confirmed only when the image unmistakably shows a different subject, a different person, or a non-performance substitute (logo, poster or book cover without the filed character, painting, statue, diagram, prop, or a photograph of the real person a role portrays). Six probable facets were left in place.
rubric: docs/MEDIA-AUDIT.md: a still must show the exact filed character as an actual depiction of the performance; a portrait must show the exact human performer out of character.

source_audit.report: UNDERCAST repository audit, 2026-10-22, section 4 (card media); evidence retained in operator-local scratch custody
source_audit.first_viewer: audit mapper a3e768a756817c6cf with two adversarial verifiers; its byte-opened list is quoted in UC-MEDIA-AUDIT-2-INCIDENT.json

action: Null each confirmed-wrong binding in data/specimens.json and data/SOURCES.json; retain the immutable image bytes under images/ as history; project every rejected object into data/MEDIA-REJECTIONS.json; rebuild the media-audit state and the serving projections; rebaseline data/quality.json to the exact corrected truth.
